The DIV re-triage measured the committed headship curve WRONG at its use site and two gate gaps. Three parts, TDD each:

PART 1 — headship RE-DERIVED (the ruling-B pattern, exactly as ownership already does it):
The use site defines the semantics: spec OwnerStock = Σ pop(a,g,t,s) × headship(a) × ownership(a), where pop is ISQ scenario population — so headship(a) = QC private-household primary maintainers in band a (committed census extract, pinned) ÷ ISQ Le Québec 2021 Référence persons in band a (committed pop-as-qc-base.xlsx, pinned). DIV-derived reference values (verify, don't trust): 20-34 0.3954, 35-54 0.5779, 55-64 0.6110, 65-74 0.6400, 75+ 0.5919; numerator closure 3,749,040 vs 3,749,035 (round-to-5); aggregate reproduces 3,749,043. Ship: a generator (regen-equality gate), a full-band independent oracle from TEST-OWNED inputs, the ruling-L load-path identity check, and Anchor-typed provenance (dated, cited — constants.py's "an undated constant is a defect" rule now enforced structurally). The 0-19 band: apply the use-site rule (15-19 maintainers ÷ 0-19 persons IS the correct per-person rate if the model multiplies pop(0-19); if no consumer multiplies it, DROP the band and record why). The old typed values die.

PART 2 — refresh-path external anchor (DIV F2): promote the P2 inner-CSV sha256 (773f7af8deac… — full value in probes/P2-census-tenure-age.md:16) from probe-note prose into pins.py or the artifact _provenance, checked at derivation; and add TWO more spec-oracle cells to test_census_ownership.py from P2's recorded published values (QC_RMR 75+ and HORS_RMR 75+ — pull the exact figures from the P2 note, cite line numbers). The composite refresh motion (re-extract + re-pin + regen) must then red somewhere a wrong vintage cannot dodge.

PART 3 — territory-note gate role-sensitivity (DIV F3): replace the five bare f"{value:,.0f}" presence asserts with contiguous-clause assertions binding each figure to its ROLE (the ca_caveat gate pattern, test_census_ownership.py:372-379 explains why bare tokens fail); the figure-swap mutant (2,740,546 <-> 2,384,575) must red.
